messages:
Claire (Sales): Team — starting POC runbook for FinOpt. They want a 4-week pilot (HIPAA scope), VPC deployment, model pinning and an eval harness. Need to finalize success criteria, POC timeline, and who owns security/pricing responses.
Aisha (AM): I have their security questionnaire and initial SOW asks. Uploading docs to the shared folder now. Also they requested SOC2 proof + data residency commitments.
security-bot: Questionnaire file shared at https://redwood.app/secure/finopt-qnrs. Assigned to Marco (Eng) and Jared (SE) for responses.
Jared (SE): Quick resource estimate: SE coverage 8 hrs/week during weeks 0-2 for deploy/tuning, then 3 hrs/week for week 3-4 for UAT & handoff. Will need eng-sre for a 2hr maintenance window during Week 1 deploy.
Marco (Eng): Tech constraints: recommend Dedicated or Private with 13B quantized model pinned. If they insist on hosted w/ peering, expect reduced throughput. Need QPS and target p95 latency to finalize sizing.
Priya (Sales Eng): Draft success criteria proposal:
- Accuracy: >=90% pass rate on customer-provided eval set (we co-create prompts)
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms single-turn at median token length
- Stability: >=99% availability during pilot window
- Security: SOC2 summary provided; audit log export available from Private/Dedicated
- Cost: pilot credit cap agreed before Week 2
Claire (Sales): Good. Customer also asked for pilot pricing and a temporary discount. Can we do a credit?
Aisha (AM): We can offer a 20% usage credit for the pilot if they agree to a follow-up procurement discussion. I'll draft the T&Cs.
Jared (SE): Proposed detailed timeline + owners:
Week 0 (kickoff): access, questionnaire, clarify dataflows — owner: Aisha — due: Fri week0
Week 1: VPC + infra deploy, model pin, baseline smoke tests — owner: Jared — due: Mon week1; 2hr maintenance window scheduled
Week 2: Integration, prompt tuning, KV/prefix cache config, run initial evals — owner: Priya — due: Fri week2
Week 3: Performance tuning, full eval run, customer UAT sessions — owner: Marco & Jared — due: Thu week3
Week 4: Acceptance checks, logs export, handoff to CS — owner: Claire & Aisha — due: Fri week4
Claire (Sales): Concrete deliverables please (add to doc):
- Security questionnaire responses — Marco (Eng) — EOD Thu
- Network diagram & CIDRs — customer -> Aisha collects — Mon
- Eval prompt set & harness — Priya — Wed week1
- Pilot credit & pricing note — Claire — Fri week1
Marco (Eng): I'll complete security answers. Need the network diagram and any data classification notes.
Aisha (AM): I'll follow up with the customer for the diagram and save it in the shared folder. Also looping in legal for SOC2 artifact requests.
Priya (Sales Eng): Scheduling: can we book a 30min kickoff with customer + SE on Monday morning PT? That'll help unblock Week 1 work.
Claire (Sales): Scheduling now, sending invites. Everyone, please update the shared doc when you claim an item. I'll post the final runbook and links in this thread.
security-bot: Access to questionnaire and runbook granted to participants. Reminder: mark any PHI flows in the doc.
